name: Woops
title: The Purple-Haired Fox Girl
description: Woops is a VRChat YouTuber and Twitch streamer, one of the five original leaders of [Team Five](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Team_Five), first known for a custom fox-girl avatar in VRChat's public worlds. Described as happy-go-lucky and mischievous but loyal to friends, he records both roleplay and casual VRChat content for his channel and is affiliated with the [Midnite Central](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Midnite_Central) community.
